name: claude-tools
description: A growing collection of Claude Code plugins and tools

plugins.name: hello-world
plugins.description: A simple hello world plugin — responds with Hello, World!

plugins.name: feature-planner
plugins.description: Guided feature planning — interviews the user, explores the codebase, and writes a structured implementation plan to ~/.claude/plans/

plugins.name: ticket-estimator
plugins.description: Estimates the AI-era cost of a PM-written ticket — scores planning complexity, review surface area, cognitive load, test complexity, and ambiguity before engineering picks it up
